g.text: Option Desk - Snapshots, history and saved results
Provider IV may be solved or retained as a labelled fallback.
Imported IV stays user-supplied. Missing IV stays absent.
Missing inputs and degradation remain visible.
Artifacts carry schema, time, versions and source metadata.
Replaced files are archived by default before atomic writes.
The dashboard reads artifacts. It does not create trades.
Schemas: shell/src/optiondesk/contracts/. Simulation and backtests consume history, not a chain in place of history.
